references.source: Talma, E. & Michele Martin. 2013. "The Status of Waste Management in Seychelles." Seychelles: Sustainability for Seychelles, GEF, SGP, & UNDP.
references.point: Point of treatment or disposal (Landfill, dumpsite, incinerator, composting plant)
references.notes: (45,000+3,500+670). Source states "All landfills are owned by the Government of Seychelles, but the landfills on Mahé are operated by STAR Seychelles, with the one at Providence receiving on average 45,000 tons of waste per year since 1999 with a maximum of 75,538 tons recorded in 2010. Those on Praslin and La Digue were initially operated by the Praslin Development fund (PDF) but with its dissolution in August 2012, LWMA has taken over. In 2005, it was estimated that the landfills on Praslin and La Digue received 3,500 tons and 670 tons respectively per year."
Value calculated based on total MSW generated per year, divided by 365 and population.

references.source: COWI. 2020. "Solid Waste Masterplan for Seychelles (2020-2035)." Delegation of the European Union to the Republic of Mauritius and to the Republic of Seychelles.
references.notes: For household waste only. Calculated based on tonnage provided in source.
